_comment: Editable starting points for jobs and everyday requests. Copy one into a new job in Tasks panel > Jobs, then set the folder and criteria for your project. Nothing here runs by itself.

jobs.name: Fix failing tests
jobs.goal: Make the failing tests in this project pass without weakening them

criteria: No test was skipped or deleted

jobs.name: Small feature with review
jobs.goal: Add <feature> with a test, reviewed before it's done

jobs.name: Coordination demo (fixtures)
jobs.goal: Watch a full plan → build → review → fix → verify cycle with scripted assistants
jobs.howTo: Tasks panel > Jobs > Run the coordination demo

requests: what finished while I was away
put that window on my other monitor
play the test game for 2 minutes
